data.narrative:
Havoc AI is a Series A–stage frontier-tech company operating in the ocean and maritime sector. The company has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe is limited: no public peers exist in this space, and only two private comparables—Seasats and Bedrock Ocean—are available for reference.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage transitions. Using the $200M total raised as a valuation proxy, this method implies a valuation of $400M. The scarcity of comparable transaction data in the ocean-tech sector restricts the applicability of revenue or margin multiples at this stage.

The triangulated range, supported by the single applicable method, spans $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. Key uncertainties center on the limited comp set, which constrains confidence in the stage-progression multiple itself, and the absence of disclosed revenue or unit economics for either Havoc AI or its peer companies. Without additional public market signals or transaction precedents in ocean and maritime technology, the range should be treated as preliminary and subject to refinement as the sector matures or additional private comparables emerge.
